verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Prophecy definitions. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
review_notes: 30 alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared substitutions; 27 structured definitions receive focused source review and one target build.

Any-player legacy families retain source-ID and in-play validation, repeated record queries, post-kill work, inclusive live scan bounds, same-controller legacy removal, opponent search exits and per-ability costs/AI scores.

Glittering Lion/Lynx retain separate static and keyword humiliation, toughness scoring, flag rechecks after callbacks and source/activation record differences. Legacy cleanup resets then returns; card cleanup resets then delegates to generic_activated_ability.
Dual Nature keeps ETB token setup, departure-query order, the affected-player snapshot across callbacks, separate named-token and source-token cleanup, and two player-ordered reverse scans.

Copper-Leaf Angel keeps the AI/trace selection limit, marked sacrifice choices, activation before processing selections, reverse order, per-item live fizzle checks and the post-kill info-slot increment. Integer slot arithmetic replaces function-pointer arithmetic.

Troubled Healer retains event guards, prevention before AI land-count scoring and once-per-turn flags. Hollow Warrior retains post-tap forbid_attack rechecks and fresh trigger globals before blocker handling.

Sunken Field retains its early return for attached non-activation events, target storage on the land and counterspell resolution; Flowering/Noxious Field retain their distinct aura delegation. Jolrael regeneration and Rhystic payment/graveyard paths retain callbacks, cancellation and result handling.
No historical replay, new tests, broad native semantic harness or reccmp refresh for this readability batch.
status: Applied 57-definition Prophecy readability batch; one target build follows. Reccmp deferred.
